solver_notes: Deterministic two-thread ABA regression model executed on aarch64; scope is the stated lockless_queue.c invariant, not a claimed patch to python/cpython. The preempted pop reads A and next=B, then the other thread performs A->B->empty->A address recycling. Legacy pointer-only CAS accepts the stale ABA and leaves head=B (the already-popped node). The fixed queue incorporates a 64-bit epoch beside the pointer and uses real ARMv8 LDAXP/STLXP double-width acquire/release CAS, with no mutex or emulated atomic in the queue path. After recycling, current epoch=3, so the expected epoch=0 CAS is rejected and head remains A. Twenty fixed repetitions and both declared pytest gates pass. objdump confirms executed binary contains LDAXP/STLXP.
